system.description: A martial artist who practices the Golden Janissary Style moves with billowing, sweeping cuts and blows like a spreading blaze, always toward the fuel of his enemy. Although his attacks look somewhat wild, his actions are actually executed with enviable precision and skill, making him no easier to evade. For the Charm's duration, the janissary's player treats rolls of 10 on a damage die as two damage successes against creatures of darkness. Additionally, the warrior can spend one mote reflexively in Step 7 of attack resolution to reduce the damage from any attack against him by two dice, to a minimum of one. Using this technique against creatures of darkness reduces the damage by five dice instead, to a minimum damage of zero.
